description: Regular soap dispensers can be really annoying; they topple easily, get clogged, stop dispensing soap properly and are hard to refill.
Introducing PENGUIN Caddy Soap Pump by Umbra
Penguin is way smarter than your average soap dispenser.

PENGUIN Caddy Soap pump is made from a molded, durable plastic bend. Its “soft-touch” coating gives it a delicate and smooth feel. The pump’s large surface area makes dispensing soap extra easy. PENGUIN is available in matte black and matte nickel finishes.

It has a clear plastic base that makes it easy to tell when soap levels are low, and unscrews easily for refilling. The container holds 12-ounces of soap and the entire dispenser measures 4 1/2 x 4 x 73/4 inches.
Order this clever soap dispenser today.
